stop.reaction: I am stopping at 30 August. The shelter has room for six behind one stone door, and I understood how I got there. But since 23 August I have had nothing to decide: no date for the riders, the same journal lines every day, and an empty-jars warning I cannot act on. I selected I would stop here in Feedback and left it unsubmitted. I would come back if the riders had a date I could prepare for.
